LEVEL_0_PROCESS_START.description: Launcher starts, Shipping executable starts, engine initializes
observed_evidence: G22: Launcher PID started, Shipping PID started within 1s
G23: Launcher PID 29728, Shipping PID 67332 within 1s
Engine: UE4 4.16.3 IpNetDriver on port 7777

LEVEL_1_LOCAL_BOOT.description: Assets load, local configuration loads, title or terminal UI appears, certificate error may remain visible
observed_evidence: G22: 7553 preload assets loaded
G22: 74693 lines of log output
G23: Game reaches title screen (SSDP discovery at T+40s indicates network initialization)
Game log shows CertError at startup but continues boot

LEVEL_2_LOCAL_UI.description: Operator can navigate non-network menus, no authenticated player identity, no vendor trust assertion
observed_evidence: G22/G23: Game reaches title screen after CertError
UI navigation: not yet confirmed by observation
Menu system: UE4 widget framework loaded

LEVEL_3_PRIVATE_SERVER_UNAUTHENTICATED.description: Independently implemented local/private-server status, no production identity, no production entitlement, no certificate-success assertion
observed_evidence: Python server: 1058 tests passing, HTTP endpoints on port 4001
Server implements: /api/health, /api/game/start, /api/game/end, /api/battle/result
No integration test with live game client

LEVEL_4_PLAYER_SESSION.description: Requires evidence for card/player flow, may remain blocked by trust
observed_evidence: G23 NesysService protocol: LCOMMAND_CONNECT_REQUEST, LCOMMAND_CLIENT_START
Certificate required for player identity (MY\.Default store)
Card operations: LCOMMAND_CARD_SELECT_REQUEST, LCOMMAND_CARD_INSERT_REQUEST

LEVEL_5_MATCHING.description: Requires confirmed private-server protocol, no production matchmaking
observed_evidence: G23: Port 1042 connection required for NesysService
Matching protocol: not yet captured from game client
No private-server matching implementation

LEVEL_6_BATTLE.description: Requires confirmed locally controlled participants and battle state
observed_evidence: G22: Port 7777 IpNetDriver (UE4 dedicated server port)
Battle protocol: not yet captured
No private-server battle implementation

LEVEL_7_RESULT.description: Requires private-server-owned result persistence, no submission to production systems
observed_evidence: Python server: /api/battle/result endpoint exists
Result persistence: SQLite/database layer implemented
No integration with live game client

key_insight: The game boots past CertError to title screen. Local UI, private-server status, and result persistence are potentially implementable without certificate trust. Player identity, matching, and battle require further protocol investigation.
